documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended 30Th June 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Pondy Oxides and Chemicals Limited (POCL) achieved record production, sales volumes, revenue, and profitability in FY26. The company expanded its lead recycling capacity to 204,000 MTPA and doubled its copper recycling capacity to 12,000 MTPA. POCL plans to invest INR 180 crores in FY27 and set up a 36,000 MTPA copper cathode plant at its TKD facility, funded entirely through internal accruals. Pondy Oxides and Chemicals Limited reported a landmark performance for FY26 with significant YoY growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by higher production and sales volumes across lead and copper segments. Management remains committed to its 'Target 2030' strategic roadmap, focusing on capacity expansions, higher value-added product contributions, and sustainable recycling practices.

guidance.claim: The company aims to deliver 20% volume growth and 20% CAGR in revenue and profitability.
guidance.quote: We continue to expand our lead and copper capacities while strengthening our presence across adjacent nonferrous recycling segments to deliver 20% volume growth and 20% CAGR in revenue and profitability.

guidance.claim: The company targets maintaining EBITDA margins above 8% and return on capital employed above 20%.
guidance.quote: Our growth is complemented by a strong focus on margin expansion with targets maintaining EBITDA margins above 8% and return on capital employed above 20%.

guidance.claim: The company strategically focuses on increasing the contribution of value-added products to over 60% over the long term.
guidance.quote: In FY '26, additionally, value-added products accounted for 65% of lead segment revenue, reinforcing our strategic focus on increasing the contribution of value-added products to over 60% over the long term.

guidance.claim: The company is looking at about 15% growth in lead volumes year-on-year.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year on the lead volumes, we are looking at about 15% in growth volumes.

guidance.claim: The company expects lead volumes to reach about 125,000 to 130,000 tons for the year.
guidance.quote: But as of now, the guidance that we can look at about 125,000 to 130,000.

guidance.claim: The company aims to sustain 15% plus volume growth and deliver over 20% revenue CAGR.
guidance.quote: The Company aims to sustain 15%+ volume growth, deliver 20%+ revenue CAGR, maintain EBITDA margins above 8% and ROCE above 20%, while increasing the contribution of value-added products to over 60%.

guidance.claim: The company expects lead capacities to ramp up to 70% in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The lead capacities are expected to ramp up to 70% in the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: Management targets maintaining EBITDA margins above 8% and ROCE above 20% aligned with its Target 2030 vision.
guidance.quote: Growth will be supported by margin improvement with a focus on maintaining EBITDA margins above 8% and ROCE above 20%.

guidance.claim: The company aims for over 60% revenue contribution from value-added products and a 20% plus reduction in energy consumption.
guidance.quote: Alongside scale and strategy emphasis, operational efficiency through innovation and modernization with a target of over 60% revenue contribution from value-added products and 20% plus reduction in energy consumption, backed by a net cash balance sheet, disciplined execution, a supportive regulatory environment, extensive land bank, experienced leadership and stakeholder support.

guidance.claim: Management targets a minimum of 12,000 metric tons of production for copper in FY27.
guidance.quote: FY '27, we are targeting a minimum of 12,000 metric tons but would be definitely higher than that.

demand_outlook.claim: Copper consumption in India is poised to go 3x in the next 3 to 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: But we need to also remember one critical part that with the energy transition and various infrastructure activities that are happening across the country and the push, our copper consumption is poised to almost go 3x in the next 3 to 4 years from almost close to 1.2 million tons to about 3 million to 3.5 million tons.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the India-EU trade deal serves as a structural catalyst that secures long-term demand visibility.
demand_outlook.quote: I would want to mention that the India-EU trade deal serves as a structural catalyst for POCL, enhancing our global price competitiveness, securing long-term demand visibility and solidifying our status as an organized compliant leader capable of meeting Europe's rigorous sustainability standards.

demand_outlook.claim: Market demand for plastics was on the softer side along with softer prices and offtakes.
demand_outlook.quote: We'll be slowly looking at trying to build those volumes. But currently, what we saw in the last quarter, the whole market demand was pretty much on the softer side, along with softer prices and offtakes as well.

demand_outlook.claim: International demand for lead is growing at about 2% to 3%.
demand_outlook.quote: And internationally, about 2% to 3% is the growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Incremental demand for lead in India is estimated between 5% and 6%.
demand_outlook.quote: For India, we are looking at anywhere between 5%, 6% of incremental demand and also the demand that comes from your regular replacement demand of existing batteries and vehicles.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved setting up a 36,000 metric tons per annum copper cathode plant at the TKD facility with an estimated investment of approximately INR 200 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Further strengthening our growth platform, the Board has approved the setting up of a 36,000 metric tons per annum copper cathode plant at our TKD facility in Tamil Nadu with an estimated investment of approximately INR 200 crores, funded purely through internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The copper cathode project will be implemented in two phases, with Phase 1 targeted for commissioning by December 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The project will be implemented in 2 phases of 18,000 metric tons per annum each and Phase 1 is targeted for commissioning by December 2026, which marks a significant step in expanding our nonferrous recycling portfolio and enhancing value-added capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to incur an additional INR 180 crores of capex in FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain committed to investing for future and expect to incur additional INR 180 crores in FY '27 to support capacity augmentation in copper, downstream integration and other strategic growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects capex for the following financial year to be in the range of INR 50 crores to INR 60 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And the following financial year will be probably in the range of INR 50 crores to INR 60 crores, unless additional anything else is specifically added, which we'll keep you updated.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will be starting up its Mundra project in FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: As indicated, in FY '27, we'll be starting up our Mundra project as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned commercial production under Phase 1 and Phase 2 of the lead capacity expansion project contributing 36,000 MTPA each.
capex_expansion.quote: Successfully commissioned commercial production under Phase 1 and Phase 2 of the Lead capacity expansion project, contributing 36,000 MTPA each in April’25 and Dec’25, respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: Copper recycling capacity was successfully doubled to 12,000 MTPA in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: Successfully doubled Copper Recycling capacityto12,000 MTPAinFY26.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex incurred in FY26 was Rs. 49 Cr. with estimated capex for FY27 at Rs. 180 Cr.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex of Rs.49 Cr. done inFY26; EstimatedCapexfor FY27 Rs.180 Cr.

capex_expansion.claim: The second phase of the lead expansion project adding 36,000 metric tons per annum was commissioned in December 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The second phase of lead expansion project, adding 36,000 metric tons per annum was commissioned and became operational in December 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: Total lead capacity increased from 132,000 metric tons per annum in FY25 to 2,04,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: As a result, the total lead capacity has increased from 132,000 metric tons per annum in FY '25 to 2,04,000 metric tons per annum, representing an increase of over 50%.

capex_expansion.claim: Copper recycling capacity is set to double from 6,000 metric tons per annum to 12,000 metric tons per annum by the end of January 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Our copper recycling capacity is set to double from 6,000 metric tons per annum to 12,000 metric tons per annum by the end of Jan 2026.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded to 7.4% in FY '26 compared to 5.3% in FY '25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded by 212 basis points to 7.4% in FY '26, compared to 5.3% in FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton of lead improved significantly by 39% to INR 18,462 in FY '26.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA per ton of lead improved significantly by 39% to INR 18,462 in FY '26 and by 43% year-on-year to INR 19,739 during the quarter, reflecting the success of our value optimization synergies.

margins_costs.claim: Copper EBITDA per ton stood at INR 39,896 per ton in FY 2026.
margins_costs.quote: FY 2026 production and sales volume of copper increased by 7x, respectively, whereas EBITDA per ton stood strong at INR 39,896 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects other expenses to be in the range of INR 20 crores to INR 25 crores moving forward.
margins_costs.quote: So in the coming years to come, the other expenses will be in the range of -- with increased volume as well, it will be in the range of INR 20 crores to INR 25 crores moving forward.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects a margin of INR 60,000 to INR 70,000 per ton on the copper cathode.
margins_costs.quote: As of now, what we can see, we are looking at about INR 60,000 to INR 70,000 per ton on the copper cathode versus INR 35,000 to INR 40,000 what we are currently doing.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 lead production and sales moderated as the company prioritized higher-margin value-added products, resulting in a 43% increase in EBITDA per ton of lead.
margins_costs.quote: Note:Q4FY26 lead production and sales moderated as the company prioritized higher-margin value-added products, resulting in a 43% increase in EBITDA per ton of lead.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton of lead increased significantly by 46% year-on-year to INR 18,086 per ton on a 9-month basis.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA per ton of lead increased significantly by 46% year-on-year to INR 18,086 per ton on a 9-month basis by 39% year-on-year to INR 17,427 per ton on a quarterly basis.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins remained strong at over 7% plus compared to over 5% in 9 months FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins remained strong at over 7% plus compared to over 5% in 9 months FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: Sustainable EBITDA per ton for lead is in the range of INR 15,000 to INR 17,500.
margins_costs.quote: INR 15,000 to INR 17,500 is something what we have -- it's a sustainable EBITDA per ton irrespective of the price movement.

margins_costs.claim: Blended EBITDA margins are expected to remain in the range of 7% to 8%.
margins_costs.quote: So the blended margins will remain in the range of 7% to 8%.

orders_capacity.claim: Lead recycling capacity at the TKD facility was enhanced by 55% to 204,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year, POCL enhanced its lead recycling capacity at the TKD facility by 55%, increasing it from 132,000 metric tons per annum to 204,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: The expanded lead facility operated at approximately 65% during FY '26 and is expected to reach nearly 75% utilization in the coming quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: The expanded facility operated at approximately 65% during FY '26 and is expected to steadily ramp up reaching nearly 75% utilization in the coming years -- coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper recycling capacity was doubled to 12,000 metric tons per annum in Q4 FY '26.
orders_capacity.quote: We also successfully doubled our copper recycling capacity to 12,000 metric tons per annum in Q4 FY '26, reinforcing our presence in the Copper Recycling segment.

orders_capacity.claim: The copper recycling facility is expected to progressively ramp up to 70% utilization during FY '27.
orders_capacity.quote: The facility is expected to progressively ramp up to 70% utilization during FY '27.

orders_capacity.claim: Lead production increased by 57% year-on-year and 26% quarter-on-quarter to 33,271 metric tons on a quarterly basis.
orders_capacity.quote: The production of lead has increased by 23% year-on-year to 83,746 metric tons on a 9-month basis and 57% year-on-year and 26% quarter-on-quarter to 33,271 metric tons on a quarterly basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales of copper increased by 15 times on a 9-month basis to INR 296 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: There is a significant increase in sales of copper by 15 times on a 9-month basis to INR 296 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Volume sales for copper were about 1,235 metric tons for the third quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Dheeraj, the volume sales for copper is about 1,235 metric tons for this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall lead capacity utilization for the 9 months ended was about 70%, and about 79.2% for the quarter alone.
orders_capacity.quote: See, overall, if you see the lead capacity utilization for this 9 months ended is about 70%. And for this quarter alone, it is about 79.2%.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR 5 per equity share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with its commitment to reward the shareholders, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR 5 per equity share, representing 100% of the face value for FY 2025 - 26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company deployed approximately INR 49 crores towards capital expenditure in FY '26.
capital_allocation.quote: Backing our growth strategy, POCL deployed approximately INR 49 crores towards capital expenditure in FY '26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is not looking at taking any debt for its further expansion or announced capex.
capital_allocation.quote: And we are not looking at taking any debt as of now, even for our further expansion or any of these capex that we've announced.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is very strongly poised to bring overall inventory days below 45 days.
capital_allocation.quote: We are very strongly poised to bring overall below 45 days as we had spoken earlier as well, and we are -- we will continue to do that.

capital_allocation.claim: POCL's Board approved the amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, POCL Future Tech into the parent company, subject to regulatory approvals.
capital_allocation.quote: POCL's Board has approved the amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, POCL Future Tech into the parent company, subject to regulatory approvals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing has faced delays of 10 to 20 days in receiving raw materials due to the war situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: There has been a little delay in overall receiving of the material, like I said earlier as well, when I was speaking with Shweta that I mean this is -- I mean, most -- there has been 10, 15 days, 20 days delay in receiving of the raw material, and that is actually the major impact.

risks_headwinds.claim: Copper prices have been extremely volatile.
risks_headwinds.quote: Copper prices have been extremely volatile and not only this quarter through the last whole year, they have been pretty volatile.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainties regarding fiscal policy, competition, inflationary pressures, and general economic conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The risks and uncertainties relating to the statements include, but are not limited to, risks and uncertainties regarding fiscal policy, competition, inflationary pressures and general economic conditions affecting demand / supply and price conditions in domestic and internationalmarkets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the whole copper market is going through an extremely volatile phase with vertical price increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The copper, as you are noticing, the whole copper market is going through extremely volatile phase. And when any metal, which almost close to 40%, 45% just shoots up in a vertical manner, overall industry, it takes a little bit of time and momentum for it to absorb these kind of price increases and which have to flow down eventually to the end consumers.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the copper cathode plant is targeted for commissioning by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The project will be implemented in 2 phases of 18,000 metric tons per annum each and Phase 1 is targeted for commissioning by December 2026, which marks a significant step in expanding our nonferrous recycling portfolio and enhancing value-added capabilities.

management_commitments.claim: The copper recycling facility is expected to progressively ramp up to 70% utilization during FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: The facility is expected to progressively ramp up to 70% utilization during FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to incur an additional INR 180 crores in FY '27 to support capacity augmentation.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to investing for future and expect to incur additional INR 180 crores in FY '27 to support capacity augmentation in copper, downstream integration and other strategic growth initiatives.

management_commitments.claim: The company will be starting up its Mundra project in FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: As indicated, in FY '27, we'll be starting up our Mundra project as well.

management_commitments.claim: POCL remains firmly on track towards achieving its Target 2030 with a strategic focus on capacity expansion across Lead, Copper, and other key segments.
management_commitments.quote: POCL remains firmly on track towards achieving its Target 2030, with a strategic focus on capacity expansion across Lead, Copper, and other key segments.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will look into the Mundra land capacity in the second half of calendar year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So Sagar, currently, as indicated earlier as well, we will be looking into Mundra only in 2027. That is now once our copper expansions are completed by this last quarter of 2026 and 2027, and post that, the Mundra land capacity will be seen.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a minimum of 12,000 metric tons of copper production for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: FY '27, we are targeting a minimum of 12,000 metric tons but would be definitely higher than that.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets delivering 20% plus volume growth and 20% plus CAGR in revenue and profitability by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: In conclusion, POCL remains aligned with its Target 2030 vision, supported by a clear road map focused on value creation and sustainable growth. The company continues to scale its lead and copper capacities while expanding into adjacent non-ferrous segments with an objective of delivering 20% plus volume growth and 20% plus CAGR in revenue and profitability.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
